summary: Advanced government securities payments training covering settlement, liquidity, legal, and operational risk. Build practical controls in five days.
lede: Payment settlement finality concerns when government securities payment obligations become irrevocable. For experienced settlement, operations, risk, treasury, legal, and audit professionals, this course addresses how to control payment flows across payment systems, securities depositories, custodians, and settlement agents. Participants map settlement flows, assess principal and liquidity exposure, test reconciliation controls, and frame legal and incident escalations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for experienced professionals who oversee, control, advise on, or audit government securities payments and their related legal and risk exposures.
prerequisites: You should have substantial experience in securities operations, treasury operations, payment systems, custody, market infrastructure, financial-market risk, legal advisory, or internal audit. Familiarity with government debt instruments, settlement instructions, reconciliations, and operational incident management is expected. No programming is required. Advanced technology topics are taught at operational application level, while legal topics use structured issue analysis and do not replace jurisdiction-specific legal advice.
